name: agent_trajectory
objective: Guard which tools the main agent actually reaches for. This is the only suite that calls the real chat model; the other five use stubs, so a model swap would leave them all green.

tool_choice_accuracy.description: Fraction of runs where the final turn called an acceptable tool and avoided the forbidden ones. Asserts the trajectory, not the answer text: wording varies run to run, while picking the wrong data source is the defect that actually happened.

constraints: This suite calls the real model and costs money, so it is deliberately NOT part of run_evals.py. Run it before a deploy that touches prompts, tools or the loop.
Assertions never depend on the user's current data. Checking for '8 races' would go red when a race is added, which is a data change rather than a defect.
Threshold is 0.9, not 1.0: the model is non-deterministic and one flaky run should not fail the suite. Use --repeat to distinguish noise from real regression.
Only the final turn is asserted. Earlier turns exist to build up the context that triggers the defect under test.

baseline.note: 建立时锁住两个真实缺陷：比赛问题被查成训练流水；追问时拿上一轮回答当数据源、编出不存在的比赛。
